parsed_blocks.text: Select Size

layout_blocks.source_html:
HOW TO MEASURE

For the best results use a tailor’s tape measure featuring both centimetres and inches. Stand in front of a mirror; you may want to ask a friend or family member to help. 


1. Bust: Take your measurement around the fullest part of your bust, keeping the tape measure level all the way around from back to front. See image point 1 for reference. 

 

2. Waist: Take your measurement around the narrowest part of your waist, making sure the tape measure is level all the way around from back to front. See image point 2 for reference.

 

3. Hip: Standing with your feet together, take your measurement around the widest part of your hips, so the tape measure sits level all the way around from back to front. See image point 3 for reference.

 

4. Inside Leg Length: Standing with your feet hip-width apart and legs straight, place the tape measure at the very top of your inside leg. Take the measurement against the inside of your thigh from the highest point to the ankle bone. See image point 4 for reference.

 

5. Wearing Length: Holding the tape measure at the side of your neck, measure in a straight line down to the hem/garment edge of your dress, top, coat or jacket. This measurement on the website provides an intended guideline for where the garment will fall on your body when worn. See image point 5 for reference.

layout_blocks.source_html: PETITE SIZE GUIDE INFORMATION

parsed_blocks.text: PETITE SIZE GUIDE INFORMATION

layout_blocks.source_html:
Our petite range is designed for women between 4ft 11” (149.86cm) and 5ft 3” (160cm).

 

The sizing is the same as our main range, with proportions carefully adjusted to suit a petite frame.

 

Here’s how our petite fit differs from the regular fit:

 

  • Shoulder width: reduced by 1cm
  • Bodice length (side neck to waist): reduced by 2cm
  • Front and back rise length: reduced by 1.5cm
  • Sleeve length: reduced by 1–4cm (style dependent)
  • Shorts leg length: reduced by 1–2cm
  • Trousers leg length: reduced by 5–7cm (style dependent)
  • Tops length: reduced by 3–7cm (style dependent)
  • Mini dresses: reduced by 5cm
  • Midi to maxi dresses: reduced by 8–10cm (style dependent)
  • Mini skirts: reduced by 3cm
  • Midi to maxi skirts: reduced by 5–8cm

editorial_blocks: DESIGNER'S NOTES: NOBODY'S CHILD X ELIZABETH SCARLETT

Designed in partnership with Elizabeth Scarlett, this limited edition collaboration reflects a shared love of original artistry, intricate craftsmanship and pieces that feel special to wear. Prints inspired by Elizabeth’s original watercolour designs are paired with embroidery and tactile finishes, creating a romantic, keepsake feel. To celebrate the collection, together we’re proud to be donating £15,000 to Blue Marine Foundation, a conservation charity dedicated to protecting and restoring life in the ocean. Read more about the collaboration here.
